title: LINKAGE SECTION — declares parameters received from caller; storage is OWNED by the caller
sourceContent:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. INCREMENT-COUNTER.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  WS-LOCAL  PIC 9(4).
       LINKAGE SECTION.
       01  LS-COUNTER PIC 9(4).
      *> The PROCEDURE DIVISION USING list names LINKAGE SECTION
      *> items, NOT WORKING-STORAGE. The storage for LS-COUNTER is
      *> the caller's variable -- mutating it mutates the caller.
      *> Java's parameter list is conceptually similar but the
      *> caller doesn't own the bytes; the spec must capture the
      *> address-of contract.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION USING LS-COUNTER.
       MAIN.
           ADD 1 TO LS-COUNTER.
           GOBACK.
notes: LINKAGE SECTION + PROCEDURE DIVISION USING is the COBOL way to declare parameters. Combined with default BY REFERENCE, mutations affect the caller. Surface this for every called subprogram.
